name: maka
description:
Star


  

  
    
    


      
        apache /

      maka  

    
      Apache Maka (Incubating) is a local-first AI agent workspace. Model messages, tool calls, tool results, permission decisions, and termination events are recorded as an append-only log.
summary: Apache Maka 是一个本地优先的AI智能体工作空间，将模型消息、工具调用及权限决策等记录为仅追加日志，确保操作透明可审计。它值得关注，因为其设计兼顾隐私与可追溯性，适合构建安全可控的自主代理系统。

name: claude-obsidian
description:
Star


  

  
    
    


      
        AgriciDaniel /

      claude-obsidian  

    
      Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code. Drop any source and Claude reads, links, and files it into one connected knowledge graph of plain Markdown you own. AI note-taking, personal knowledge management (PKM), and an open-source Notion alternative. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.
summary: claude-obsidian 是一个将 Obsidian 与 Claude Code 结合的自组织 AI 第二大脑工具，能自动读取、链接并归档任意来源的内容为互联的 Markdown 知识图谱。它基于 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式，提供开源的个人知识管理方案，可作为 Notion 的替代品。
